hooks.command: echo 'Call start with a short task description before answering or acting on a work task so active team rules and matching cases load (call recall with narrower words if rules_more is nonzero or partial). Save user rules or corrections with record or correct (never secrets), cite exact Receipts, query Worlds via search with sources and dates, and re-read via recall before pay, release, send, or delete actions.'

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SubagentStart","additionalContext":"When Phasis tools are available, read the Phasis case your parent named via recall (about set to the case id, with k up to 50 and narrower queries if partial; otherwise call start with your task) before acting, even if your prompt summarizes earlier decisions, and apply its active rules. Re-read the case via recall right before any action that pays, releases, sends, or deletes; if a read fails or is partial, ask before acting.
